author: chat-batch
review_scope: Single AI author wrote every phrase as a common instant-messaging turn (questions, replies, particles, pronoun-verb chunks, feelings, plans) and checked each reading in chat use. Phrases equal to a held-out colloquial test line, or a 3+ character piece of one, were dropped so tests/data/colloquial_test.tsv stays held out. Not an independent human linguistic review and not a bulk import.
pronunciation_dependency: pypinyin 0.55.0 authoring-only; default agreement is not a review decision
frequency_policy: Fixed coarse project-relative category bands before native evaluation; no measured corpus frequencies or tuning to public answer ranks.
source_policy: Project-authored chat phrases, not taken from tests/data or any third-party lexicon. Phrases already present in any dictionary layer were left out, so existing entries and weights are unchanged.
